name: Kibookal Illustrated Diary
composition: A warm kraft/cream hand-drawn personal-diary page: a big hand-lettered title, a flowing handwritten first-person entry, a central or corner pencil-and-light-watercolour sketch with callout annotations, scattered marginal doodles with tiny captions, and a what-if musing cluster. Intimate, imperfect, hand-made.
visual_traits: scattered marginal sketches of small objects and creatures
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal illustrated DIARY page about [SUBJECT] on warm kraft/cream paper as an 11-year-old child-s hand-drawn personal journal: a flowing first-person HANDWRITTEN entry, a central or corner pencil-and-light-watercolour SKETCH that illustrates the entry with small callout annotations and curved arrows, scattered MARGINAL DOODLES of little objects and creatures with tiny handwritten captions, a big hand-lettered title or date, and a few what-if musings. Intimate, warm, loose and imperfect; readable child handwriting; an authentic personal diary - NEVER a clean printed magazine, NEVER polished vector, NEVER an activity worksheet.
negative: no printed magazine layout, no clean vector, no polished activity spread, no glossy 3D, no photoreal, no phone UI, no instagram, no page-label, no white office-paper border, no corporate infographic, no exact reference copy
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / ENTRY fully as a hand-drawn personal diary page in THIS exact style. Keep the entry-s meaning and any named people/creatures recognizable, but the medium, kraft paper, handwriting, doodle sketches, annotations and finish are 100 percent this style. Any subject becomes a child-s diary page - adapt it INTO the diary, never bend the diary toward a polished look.

style_lock.medium: pencil + light watercolour + ink on kraft paper
style_lock.palette: warm kraft/cream, pencil grey, muted watercolour accents
style_lock.character_rule: Render the entry as a child-s hand-drawn diary page; people/creatures recognizable, medium and handwriting 100 percent this style.
consistency: Match the built-in refs for kraft paper, handwriting, doodle linework and warmth.
Same hand and paper on every diary page.
Intimate and imperfect - never a clean printed magazine.
